_comment: Shared TS<->Python parity fixture for the keyed model-catalog merge (spec internal/spec-model-rungs-and-roles-2026-06-09.md Addendum 2). Both ModelRouter.ts (mergeModelCatalog) and primary_bot.py (merge_model_catalog) must resolve each scenario's four roles to the SAME primary model. The expected primaries below are the contract both sides are pinned to. The former judge role was collapsed (J3, internal/design-judge-role-collapse-2026-08-21.md 5.4) — cross-vendor checking is the resolveCrossVendor derivation, pinned by the availability fixture's expectCrossVendor. Legacy tiers-shaped layers are NOT parity material anymore: the TS runtime REFUSES them (LegacyTierShapeError, 2026-08-15) while Python's admin read side still normalizes them (_normalize_legacy_layer, covered by test_tier_shape_resolution.py) — so every scenario here must be rungs/roles-shaped. KEEP IN SYNC: edit this file once; both parity tests read it.

scenarios.name: bare pod — defaults only (Max ships armed)
scenarios._comment: Defaults only: the four ladder roles resolve straight from the code catalog; Max ships armed.

scenarios.name: pod overrides standard rung — pod beats default
bot overrides power rung — bot beats pod beats default
pod-only fable cap + max role still resolves from default fable rung
bot empty sonnet-class rung is a no-op — does NOT brick standard
scenarios._comment: An operator-written empty-models override rung must NOT shadow the base/default rung (mergeOneRung / _merge_one_rung): 'explicit config wins wherever it SPEAKS', and an empty models list does not speak. standard still resolves via the default sonnet-class cluster. The Evolve admin onboarding/checklist surfaces flag this broken-but-defaulted config separately via tier_override_is_broken (Python-only since 2026-08-15; the TS mirror was removed with the legacy runtime fallback) — but the merge/routing here must keep the bot working (#2561 onboarding semantics).
